task: Fix issue #3502: make PR check reporting mergeability-aware, register merge drivers for runner merges, close fresh-clone registration gaps, and document the GitHub merge-ref limitation.

events.content: Read issue #3502 and all comments with gh issue view 3502 --comments. The later owner comment changed the runner interpretation: plain runner registration is unsafe if it executes PR-controlled driver code with BOT_PAT in scope.
Captured the pre-fix live PR check proof on PR #3478: get_pr_checks.py returned exit 0 and AllPassing true without any MergeState fields.
Added red tests for MergeState propagation, CONFLICTING and UNKNOWN fail-closed behavior, and exit code 1 when checks pass but the merge ref is unusable. Initial targeted run: 5 failed, 77 passed.
Added red tests for MergeState propagation, CONFLICTING and UNKNOWN fail-closed behavior, and exit code 1 when checks pass but the merge ref is unusable. Initial targeted run: 5 failed, 77 passed.
Added red tests for MergeState propagation, CONFLICTING and UNKNOWN fail-closed behavior, and exit code 1 when checks pass but the merge ref is unusable. Initial targeted run: 5 failed, 77 passed.

Extended get_pr_checks.py to query mergeable and mergeStateStatus, emit MergeState, MergeStateStatus, MergeRefUsable, and MergeStateWarning, and return exit 1 when the merge ref is CONFLICTING, DIRTY, or UNKNOWN.

Added a trusted-copy mode to install_merge_drivers.py. CI registration copies the stdlib-only driver under the git common dir before checkout, then registers that copy so PR-controlled branches cannot replace the command run during merge.
Registered merge drivers inside resolve_pr_conflicts.py before local merges. Runner mode uses trusted-copy registration before checkout. Worktree mode registers before creating the merge worktree.
Registered trusted merge drivers in pr-maintenance.yml before its inline git merge steps. Workflow validation passed with the pre-existing ADR-006 size warning.

Closed the local-developer gap by running install_merge_drivers.py in bootstrap-vm.sh, documenting it in README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md setup, and adding a pre-push lefthook job so a missing driver self-heals or fails before push.

Recorded the GitHub merge-ref limitation in .gitattributes next to the causal graph driver. GitHub backend merge refs cannot use local git config or execute repository setup code; durable fixes are stop committing, shard, regenerate after merge, or accept merge-queue conflict handling.

Reproduced the merge-driver failure and fix with one constructed pair of commits: no driver produced CONFLICT and exit 1; installer and CI trusted-copy modes both merged cleanly to tree ff22fdb31d6953a85b089406d53f44498e246e73 with nodes feature, main, shared.

Validated targeted files: 225 passed across tests/test_get_pr_checks.py, tests/validation/test_merge_causal_graph.py, and tests/skills/merge-resolver/test_resolve_pr_conflicts.py; ruff passed on changed Python files.
